authenticity_review: The image demonstrates high technical fidelity in material rendering (dough porosity, icing viscosity, lighting). However, it exhibits structural artifacts in the cookie geometry: several trumpet shapes have topologically impossible tubing loops or merged valve components that defy both real instrument anatomy and plausible cookie cutter physics. These are severity-2 structural collapses. The primary authenticity issue is semantic: the model hallucinated a pattern of decorated cookies instead of generating the requested scene composition.
